product_metadata.title: Manual Food Processor Vegetable Chopper, Ourokhome Portable Hand Pull String Garlic Mincer Onion Cutter for Veggies, Ginger, Fruits, Nuts, Herbs, etc, 2 Cup, Dark Blue
features: ◑ Time-saving and Effective Vegetable Chopper: Do you spend a lot of time chopping ingredients every day? Do you cry every time you chop onions? Does your hand smell like garlic all day after you chop it? A manual kitchen processor can completely change these conditions! Pull the cord in seconds and you will get chopped food, and you can control the size of food by the times you pull string. Pulling the string 10 times for coarse chopping, 15 times for medium, and 20 times or more for puree.

◑ A Versatile Garlic Grinder: You may ask, does it only chop garlic and onions? The answer, of course, is NO. It's small, but it can chop up a lot of things. For example, you can use it to chop up avocados for your guacamole and tomatoes for your tomato sauce. It can also chop coriander for your pesto and all kinds of fruits to make smoothies. You can also prepare a variety of nutritious supplements for your baby. This mini chopper also help you make nutritious foods for your baby.

◑ Amazing Speedy Veggie Chopper: Why is it so powerful? That's because of the structure of hand mincer. It turns the blades by pulling the cord, pull the rope once and the blades turn at least 12 times. 3 curved blades rotate in different directions and levels, this allows the blades to have maximum contact with the ingredients, all the ingredients can be chop evenly, so it's very efficient to get the results you want.

◑ Portable Garlic Crusher: 2 cup capacity manual food chopper, it is very fit for small kitchens, RVs, travel, camping and so on. What's more, it doesn't require any electricity to operate at all, you can use it anytime, anywhere. ◑ Easy Clean: The blades are top rack dishwasher safe. Clean the bowl just under the running water.

◑ Practical Gift for Many Occasion: Our onion chopper cutter will be a thoughtful and practical gift to reduce reduce the amount of work involved in chopping every meal, whether it is for yourself or for friends and your loved ones. ◑ Satisfaction Guaranteed: We not only sell hand chopper but also provide 365-day warranty service. If you have any questions of our ginger chopper, please feel free to contact us. Your satisfaction is always our top priority!
